units.source_text: 书仓同时是一个在线的电子书刊存放与管理平台，

en.t: Shucang is also an online platform for storing and managing electronic books and periodicals,

units.source_text: 在此基础上人们可以彼此分享，共同拥有海量的内容资源。

en.t: and on this basis people can share with one another and jointly access a vast amount of content resources.
